description_en: 2+1+2 APARTMENT FOR SALE - GREEN CITY, TIRANA 📍 Green City 🏢 Floor 3 (with elevator) 📐 110 m² 💶 250,000 € Fully furnished and equipped apartment, with living room + functional kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (one master), heating/cooling air conditioners, washing machine & dishwasher. The complex offers green gardens, 2 private swimming pools, playgrounds, parking & garages, as well as every facility nearby (market, pharmacy, coffee bar). ✅ Ideal for family residence or premium investment
